response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to event-driven systems and AI-agent tooling, but lacks demonstrable production-scale multi-agent AI architecture in fintech, regulatory AI deployment experience, and leadership scaling teams beyond 10 people — critical gaps for a CTO role in high-stakes agentic AI fintech.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP tooling at re:cinq
Proven track record building event-driven, scalable systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture advocacy (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source)
concerns: No evidence of designing or operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech environments
Lacks documented experience scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ or developing senior technical leadership layers
No mention of real-time credit risk, working-capital algorithms, or financial compliance infrastructure
